extras: This plugin is currently developed and tested on macOS only and may not function correctly on Windows or Linux due to system differences.
intentEvidence: Unlike other PDF export plugins that rely on browser rendering (and often produce huge files), this plugin uses Python (reportlab + Pillow) as the rendering engine
motivation: To provide precise control over image quality, reliable CJK font support, and significantly smaller PDF files compared to browser-based export methods.
problem: Existing PDF export plugins often rely on browser rendering, leading to large file sizes and inadequate support for complex character sets like CJK.
summary: A Markdown export plugin that converts notes to PDF using a Python rendering engine, supporting image compression and reliable CJK font rendering.
